name: Labelwise – AI Content Label & AI Disclosure Badge
author: marzoni

sections.description:
Labelwise is an AI content label plugin for WordPress. It lets you tell your readers, in one click, when a post or page was written with the help of AI, and when a human has reviewed it.

Readers, search engines and regulators increasingly expect websites to be open about AI use. Labelwise gives you a simple, consistent AI disclosure on every article, without touching your theme or writing any code.

Watch the 40-second demo

How it works

  1. Open any post or page and pick a status in the AI disclosure box.
  2. Choose one of three labels: AI-assisted, AI-generated, or AI-assisted, reviewed by a human.
  3. A clean, accessible badge appears above or below your content, or wherever you place the [labelwise_badge] shortcode.

Free features

  • AI disclosure box in the editor for posts, pages and any public post type you choose.
  • Accessible AI content label badge with proper landmark and label markup, shown above or below the content.
  • Shortcode [labelwise_badge] to place the badge anywhere, including inside page builders and block themes.
  • Light and dark badge styles, with your own wording for every label so it matches your tone and language.
  • Human review record: optional “Reviewed by” name and date shown in the badge.
  • AI policy link: optional “Learn more” link to your own AI-use policy page.
  • AI label column in the Posts and Pages lists, plus an overview of how many items carry each label.
  • Privacy friendly: no tracking, no external requests, no data leaves your site.
  • Lightweight: the badge stylesheet loads only on pages that actually display a badge.

Who is it for?

  • Publishers, bloggers and news sites that use AI tools for drafting, research or translation.
  • Agencies and freelancers who manage client websites and need a repeatable AI transparency workflow.
  • Companies that want a visible AI disclosure ahead of transparency rules such as the EU AI Act.
  • Editors who want a clear record of which content a human has checked.

Labelwise Pro

Need more control? Labelwise Pro is a separate package that adds:

  • Publishing gate: hold AI-labelled content as “Pending review” until an editor marks it as human-reviewed.
  • Review log: who changed which label, and when.
  • Machine-readable markers: a <meta> tag, a REST API field and an RSS element.
  • Chatbot notice shortcode: [labelwise_chatbot_notice] to tell visitors they are talking to an AI assistant.
  • AI-use policy page generator: a starting template you review and adapt.

Get Labelwise Pro — optional paid upgrade, sold by Freemius.

Important

Labelwise helps you document and disclose AI use. It is not legal advice and does not guarantee compliance with any law or regulation. Check the rules that apply to you and your content.

Privacy

Labelwise stores its settings and the label you choose for each post in your own WordPress database. It does not collect, analyse or send any data to external services.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/labelwise, or install it from the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate it.
  3. Go to Labelwise in the admin menu and choose where the badge appears.
  4. Edit a post or page and pick a status in the “AI disclosure” box.
sections.faq:
What is an AI content label?

It is a short, visible notice telling readers that a page was written with AI help, fully generated by AI, or reviewed by a human after AI assistance. Labelwise adds this label as a badge on your posts and pages.

Does this plugin detect AI-written text?

No. You choose the label for each piece of content. Labelwise does not analyse or send your text anywhere.

Does Labelwise make my site compliant with the EU AI Act or other laws?

No. It helps you show and document what you disclose. It is not legal advice and does not guarantee compliance with any law or regulation.

Can I show the badge only on some pages?

Yes. The badge only appears on content that has a label. Set the position to “Do not insert” to place it manually with the [labelwise_badge] shortcode.

Can I change the wording of the badge?

Yes. Every label can be rewritten in the settings, so you can use your own words or your own language.

Does it work with page builders and block themes?

The badge is added to the post content and is also available as a shortcode, so it works wherever shortcodes are supported.

Does it slow down my site?

No. Labelwise makes no external requests, and its small stylesheet only loads on pages that display a badge.

Can I use it on custom post types?

Yes. In the settings, tick any public post type under “Enable on”.

What is the difference between the free plugin and Labelwise Pro?

The free plugin covers labelling, the badge and the editor box. Pro adds the publishing gate, the review log, machine-readable markers, the chatbot notice and the policy page generator. Pro is a separate package.

0.1.2

0.1.1
